Desc_0.en: A famous music piece passed down through Taiwu Village and conveyed by word of mouth, evokes old dreams among the villagers...
Desc_0.cn: 一首太吾村中流传的名曲，经由村人口耳相传，昔日旧梦，重浮心头……

Desc_1.en: A famous music piece from an unnamed place. Its composer remains unknown, yet its profound ambiance resonates deeply with the soul...
Desc_1.cn: 一首无名之地流传的名曲，不知何人所作，却是意境悠远，与心相通……

Desc_2.en: A famous music piece from the Shaolin Sect has been heard by the monks within the temple for hundreds of years, helping to center the mind, enhance endurance, and deepen meditation...
Desc_2.cn: 一首源自少林派的名曲，数百年来，寺中僧人耳闻此曲，定心忍性，潜心修行……

Desc_3.en: A famous music piece from the Emei Sect incorporates the best of many styles. Said to clear the ears and brighten the eyes, it is especially suitable for contemplation...
Desc_3.cn: 一首源自峨眉派的名曲，据传此曲博采众长，闻之耳清目明，更宜静思……

Desc_4.en: A famous music piece from Valley of Flowers, characterized by its deep, gentle sounds and warm essence, can soothe the heart...
Desc_4.cn: 一首源自百花谷的名曲，幽幽曲音，暖意融融，更可抚慰人心……

Desc_5.en: A famous music piece from the Wudang Sect embodies the harmony of yin and yang and exudes an aura of immortality and virtue. It is capable of moving mountains with minimal effort, balancing action and stillness...
Desc_5.cn: 一首源自武当派的名曲，阴阳相生，仙风道骨，动静之间四两可拨千斤……

Desc_6.en: A famous music piece from the Yuanshan Sect, though wordless, stabilizes the spirit and aids in vanquishing demons and eradicating evil...
Desc_6.cn: 一首源自元山派的名曲，曲中无词，却可定人心，助人降魔除恶……

Desc_7.en: A famous music piece from the Lion-Face Clan, filled with passion and uplifting spirits, presents a heroic and impressive stance when executed...
Desc_7.cn: 一首源自狮相门中的名曲，一腔热血，激奋昂扬，出手时更显英姿飒爽……

Desc_8.en: A famous music piece from the Ranshan Sect is pleasing to the ear yet seemingly hollow, provoking deep reflection.
Desc_8.cn: 一首源自然山派中的名曲，虽极悦耳，却似曲中空空，不由引人深思……

Desc_9.en: A famous music piece from the Jade-Maiden Sect, known for its rhythmic fluctuations and cool, graceful turns, makes it difficult to discern the presence of emotion.
Desc_9.cn: 一首源自璇女派的名曲，韵律起伏，清冷婉转，更是难辨有情无情……

Desc_10.en: A famous music piece from the Swordsmith Villa evokes the imagery of smithing a celestial weapon and is full of intriguing implications...
Desc_10.cn: 一首源自铸剑山庄的名曲，耳闻此曲，有如锻造神兵，意趣横生……

Desc_11.en: A famous music piece from the Kongsang Sect is akin to seeking eternal life, freeing the mind of distractions and quietly watching the spring snow melt away...
Desc_11.cn: 一首源自空桑派的名曲，恰似苦求长生，心无他物，静观春雪消融……

Desc_12.en: A famous music piece from the Vajra Sect features full and deep chanting tones that, though slightly eerie, fortify the heart like unyielding metal...
Desc_12.cn: 一首源自金刚宗的名曲，梵呗圆音，虽有几分诡谲，亦令人心如金石……

Desc_13.en: A famous music piece from the Five Immortals Sect captivates the ear with its melodious twists and enlightens the mind at the slightest touch...
Desc_13.cn: 一首源自五仙教的名曲，婉转曲调入耳，七窍玲珑，一点即通……

Desc_14.en: A famous music piece from the Veil Scar Sect, filled with lurking dangers and hidden traces, reveals its sharpness only in moments of calm...
Desc_14.cn: 一首源自界青门的名曲，曲中危机，藏踪蹑迹，锋芒显露之时，更可泰然处之……

Desc_15.en: A famous music piece from the Fuloong Sanctuary evokes the imagery of being protected by a Divine Loong, naturally invigorating one's vigor and courage...
Desc_15.cn: 一首源自伏龙坛的名曲，闻之犹如神龙庇佑，自有血气之勇随之加身……

Desc_16.en: A famous music piece from the Sanguine Sect startles and intrigues with its strange music, inexplicably filled with a nameless fervor...
Desc_16.cn: 一首源自血犼教的名曲，此曲乐声骇异，不知何故，却有几分无名狂热……

Desc_17.en: A famous music piece from the Capital that, once played, conjures images of splendid palaces and golden pavilions, transforming the universe yet remaining as Immovable Mountain...
Desc_17.cn: 一首京城流传的名曲，曲音一起，琼楼金阙如现眼前，乾坤变换，仍不动如山……

Desc_18.en: A famous music piece from Chengdu that cleanses the heart, much like the bright moon illuminating a person, bringing total comfort and relaxation...
Desc_18.cn: 一首成都流传的名曲，乐音清心，恰似皎洁月照人，尽是惬意舒心……

Desc_19.en: A famous music piece from Guizhou, depicts a light boat gracefully sailing away, epitomizing free spirit, even though the mountains and rivers are far...
Desc_19.cn: 一首桂州流传的名曲，虽知山水迢迢，却见一叶轻舟翩然而去，好不逍遥……

Desc_20.en: A famous music piece from Xiangyang carries the tender sentiment of the Xiang River, flowing softly through a hundred turns, yet embodies the martial spirit of the people—delicate, yet firm and resolute...
Desc_20.cn: 一首襄阳流传的名曲，襄水柔情百转，然人风尚武，恰如此曲不失婉妙，却更兼有刚毅之气……

Desc_21.en: A famous music piece from Taiyuan celebrates the city's history and its many loyal and righteous figures. This tribute to heroes is unmatched in bravery and soars with pride...
Desc_21.cn: 一首太原流传的名曲，龙城历世旷远，忠臣义士辈出，此曲更是祝颂英豪，悍勇无双，豪气冲云……

Desc_22.en: A famous music piece from Guangzhou features a lively rhythm, as if mocking the waves and laughing at Loongs, evoking a bustling morning market filled with greetings, farewells, and playful banter...
Desc_22.cn: 一首广州流传的名曲，此曲韵律轻快，好似谑浪笑敖，恰如喧嚣早市迎来送往，谐戏不止……

Desc_23.en: A famous music piece from Qingzhou weaves flute notes to depict landscapes and captures the delightful calls of birds greeting the morning sun...
Desc_23.cn: 一首青州流传的名曲，笛音错落，一写山水之音，更写尽禽悦朝晖，啼鸣之声……

Desc_24.en: A famous music piece from Jiangling begins with a subdued melody that then expands, mirroring a mind calm as still water that ultimately reveals a clear, vast sky and an immense universe...
Desc_24.cn: 一首江陵流传的名曲，音韵沉抑，继而开阔，若心如止水，终能见碧天如练，乾坤浩荡……

Desc_25.en: A famous music piece from Fuzhou evokes the lush, sprawling banyan trees that cast wide shadows over the hills, offering peace and tranquility despite the blazing sun...
Desc_25.cn: 一首福州流传的名曲，榕木郁茂扶疏，广荫原丘，虽有骄阳，亦能得神闲气静……

Desc_26.en: A famous music piece from Liaoyang is solemn and commanding, echoing the mighty Liao River as it flows unstoppably into the sea.
Desc_26.cn: 一首辽阳流传的名曲，此曲肃杀，如见滚滚辽水，入海而去，势不可挡……

Desc_27.en: A famous music piece from Qinzhou, brimming with exotic charm, intoxicates listeners and invites them to revel in its delights and sing joyously...
Desc_27.cn: 一首秦州流传的名曲，曲中满是异域风情，直叫人沉醉其中，快意当歌……

Desc_28.en: A famous music piece from Dali, light and carefree, as if accustomed to the world's turmoil, yet still finding joy in contentment...
Desc_28.cn: 一首大理流传的名曲，满篇轻巧无忧，好似见惯世间纷扰，仍可怡然自乐……

Desc_29.en: A famous music piece from Shouchun begins by holding back before soaring. The more one listens, the more melodiously it unfolds, soothing the heart.
Desc_29.cn: 一首寿春流传的名曲，此曲欲扬先抑，愈是静听，愈觉宛转悠扬，安心恬荡……

Desc_30.en: A famous music piece from Hangzhou features the delicate, lingering sounds of the zither and flute, as if one were by the West Lake under moonlight, in a painted boat carrying wine...
Desc_30.cn: 一首杭州流传的名曲，琴笛之音窈窕绵长，恰似置身月下西湖，画船载酒……

Desc_31.en: A famous music piece from Yangzhou captures the essence of spring in the Jiangnan region, imbued with delicate sentiments that make one's heart yearn for more...
Desc_31.cn: 一首扬州流传的名曲，笙歌鼎沸，曲中皆是江南春色，缕缕幽情，更令人心向往之……

Desc_32.en: A famous music piece from Jingji, composed by descendants of nobility and scored with grand traditional Chinese musical scales, resonates with the rise and fall of fortunes...
Desc_32.cn: 一首流传于京畿的名曲，相传乃贵胄遗族所作，谱以黄钟大吕、玉振金声，一曲道尽兴衰浮沉……

Desc_33.en: A famous music piece from Bashu evokes deep emotions in travelers lamenting the treacherous Sichuan paths and vowing to conquer their difficulties...
Desc_33.cn: 一首流传于巴蜀的名曲，行旅之人，无不慨叹蜀道艰险回环，誓要力克蜀道之难……

Desc_34.en: A famous music piece from Guangnan, sung by boatmen while boating on the Li River, echoes continuously between the mountains lining the banks...
Desc_34.cn: 一首流传于广南的名曲，泛舟于漓水之上，听得艄公颂唱此曲，便于夹岸群山之间回荡不绝……

Desc_35.en: A famous music piece from Jingbei offers a vast and distant vista, as if one were sitting atop a high building, overlooking the endless river flowing into the horizon...
Desc_35.cn: 一首流传于荆北的名曲，曲中之境开阔辽远，如坐于高楼之上，俯观江水连天，奔腾不息……

Desc_36.en: A famous music piece from Shanxi, often sung by Martial World heroes traversing desolate ridges and accompanied by the harsh northern wind and strong liquor, instantaneously evokes a spirit of boldness...
Desc_36.cn: 一首流传于山西的名曲，每有江湖侠士穿行荒岭，以朔风烈酒为伴，口中高歌此曲，便觉豪气顿生……

Desc_37.en: A famous music piece from Guangdong, highly favored by traveling merchants, depicts the continuous mountains, seas, and bustling human activities...
Desc_37.cn: 一首流传于广东的名曲，深受往来客商所喜，曲中海山连绵，又有人烟繁盛之象……

Desc_38.en: A famous music piece from Shandong, composed by ancient scholars who, after observing the secular world, attained enlightenment and was buried in the woods and springs, leaving this melody to the world...
Desc_38.cn: 一首流传于山东的名曲，古有高士阅尽红尘，悟得真道，终归林泉之下，而将此曲留于人间……

Desc_39.en: A famous music piece from Jingnan recalls a woman from Hunan, deep in thought and clinging to her yearnings, who walked along the riverbank singing this tune to express her melancholy...
Desc_39.cn: 一首流传于荆南的名曲，昔时湘女思慕难已，款步行于水畔，便吟此曲以抒胸中忧悒……

Desc_40.en: A famous music piece from Fujian mirrors listening to the tides at night—surging forward, then receding, sweeping away all distracting thoughts...
Desc_40.cn: 一首流传于福建的名曲，如夜听海潮涨落，忽而涌至，忽而远逝，百般杂念亦随之而去……

Desc_41.en: A famous music piece from Liaodong evokes the imagery of the celestial landscape of Heaven Lake, shrouded in mist, with an obscured path ahead that beckons further exploration...
Desc_41.cn: 一首流传于辽东的名曲，闻之如见天池之境，云雾缭绕，前路朦胧更引人一探究竟……

Desc_42.en: A famous music piece from the Western Regions, originally used by nomadic tribes to welcome guests, features exotic singing and dancing that enchants both arrivals and departures...
Desc_42.cn: 一首流传于西域的名曲，原是塞外胡人迎客之乐，高朋满座，皆有异域歌舞，送往迎来……

Desc_43.en: A famous music piece from Yunnan, with tonalities and style derived from the customs of the Miao territories, distinct from Han music, possesses a unique charm passed down through generations...
Desc_43.cn: 一首流传于云南的名曲，其音色调式承自苗疆风习，虽与汉地迥异，却是别有韵致，代代相传……

Desc_44.en: A famous music piece from Huainan that is quiet and subdued, akin to living in seclusion in a lone village, where one calms the mind by gazing at the mountains and becomes indifferent to worldly affairs...
Desc_44.cn: 一首流传于淮南的名曲，此曲静儿幽抑，如同隐卧孤村，望峰息心，从此不问世事……

Desc_45.en: A famous music piece from Jiangnan captures the scene where the setting sun illuminates the water and deepens the shadows of elm and mulberry at dusk. It's as if one can hear birds chirping back and forth, cleansing and calming the mind...
Desc_45.cn: 一首流传于江南的名曲，夕阳照水，桑榆暮影，更如耳闻鸣禽来去，清心宁神……

Desc_46.en: A famous music piece from Jiangbei features lively music that evokes the sound of immortals clapping and laughing, leading one to wander joyfully through the fields and countryside...
Desc_46.cn: 一首流传于江北的名曲，曲中乐音活泼，好似仙人拍手嬉笑，引人而去，徜徉郊野……

Evaluation_0.en: "The music piece, Words from the Past... For some reason, I feel that it must have a deep connection with you. Its melody is so haunting and graceful, filled with loneliness and a sense of destiny. It twists and turns, as if it has experienced countless cycles of reincarnation, forever entangled in various complexities..."
Evaluation_0.cn: “《前世言》此曲……不知何故，我只觉此曲必与你关系不浅，曲调如此悠长宛转，满篇孤独之意、宿命之感，千回百转，如历经千世轮回一般，永远百般纠葛……”

Evaluation_1.en: "The music piece Endless Search... It is the harmony of Xiao and Guqin, intertwining and playing together softly.There is both a serene tranquility and a sense of ancient solitude.The more one listens, the more it feels like stepping into a land of immortals, becoming gradually lost and disoriented, unsure of the origin..."
Evaluation_1.cn: “《浮世寻》此曲……乃是萧与古琴之和鸣，二者相依，幽幽而奏，既有淡泊悠远的宁静，又有几分旷古一人的寂寥。愈听愈感，似正渐渐步入仙境之中，恍惚迷失方向，不知来处……”

Evaluation_2.en: "The music piece Morning Lesson... Serene and solemn, with a hint of Buddhist tranquility, as if hundreds of martial monks were swinging their cudgels in unison, orderly and powerful, full of righteousness and integrity, not allowing any evil to intrude..."
Evaluation_2.cn: “《早课》此曲……庄严肃穆，更有几分沉静佛性，好似数百武僧齐齐挥舞棍棒，整齐划一，刚正有力，浑然一身正气，不容邪祟所侵……”

Evaluation_3.en: "The music piece Mist and Rain in Emei... The melody lives up to its name, resembling the thin misty drizzle on Mt. Emei, gently and continuously falling. As the melody progresses, the musical notes interchange, portraying a curtain of rain woven by fine showers, nourishing everything and depicting the concept of softness overcoming strength..."
Evaluation_3.cn: “《峨眉雾雨》此曲……曲如其名，恰似峨眉山上薄薄雾雨，徐徐绵绵却不肯停歇；再听后段的旋律，乐音不断交替，更描绘出一波波细雨所织就的雨帘，润泽万物，至柔克刚……”

Evaluation_4.en: "The music piece Blossom Sea... The melody is beautiful and harmonious, listening to it is like being in a beautiful sea of flowers, with the wind blowing through the flowers, layer upon layer of flower waves. Not only does it bring tranquility to the heart, but it also feels as if all bodily ailments could be healed in the blink of an eye..."
Evaluation_4.cn: “《花海》此曲……曲调优美熙和，闻之恍如置身绮丽花海，风吹百花，花浪层层，不仅心中怡然，更觉浑身病痛似是眨眼便可痊愈……”

Evaluation_5.en: "The music piece Tiangang Stars... It possesses a grand spirit and heroic demeanor, stirring the soulyet also carries a hint of circularity and perpetual flow, akin to the balance of yin and yang in the cosmos, the birth of dualism from the Taiji principle..."
Evaluation_5.cn: “《天罡》此曲……既有浩气英风，荡气回肠；又有几分迂回循环，往复流转之意，正可谓天地有阴阳，太极生两仪……”

Evaluation_6.en: "The music piece Wordless Chant... The melody, though tranquil and serene, resembles the tranquility of deep mountains with drifting clouds. Upon closer listening, there is a hint of serene Chan. With a calm and unwavering heart, without words as the key, it can dispel demons, cleanse the world..."
Evaluation_6.cn: “《无字诀》此曲……旋律虽静谧惬意，恰似悠悠深山，云烟漂浮；细听更有几分寂然禅意。心定不动，无字为诀，正可除魔降妖，荡涤世间……”

Evaluation_7.en: "The music piece Nine Dances of Majestic Lion... There is not much of a graceful and winding melody, only the sound of drums and gongs during the lion dance. It is fast and urgent, coming like a sudden storm, making people unable to help but chuckle, yet also difficult to ignore its momentum..."
Evaluation_7.cn: “《雄狮九舞》此曲……倒无甚宛转旋律，唯有舞狮之时鸣击乐声，既快且急，来时恰如暴风骤雨，叫人忍俊不禁，又难以忽视其威势……”

Evaluation_8.en: "The music piece Clouds Surrounding the Ranshan Mountain... The melody is ethereal, with ever-changing musical phrases. It can be said that it transcends worldly affairs and seeks freedom from within the heart. Just like floating clouds, they may still linger around the mountains, but one never knows when they will ascend and fly away..."
Evaluation_8.cn: “《云绕然山》此曲……旋律飘渺，乐句形态更不断变幻，可谓是不观红尘观世外，皆是随心求自在；正如浮云，虽仍然萦绕然山，却也不知何时便会飞升而去……”

Evaluation_9.en: "The music piece Bright Moonlight... In the past, I often played Guqin in the Jade-Maiden Peak, and I have heard of it. At that time, I only heard occasional singing of women in the music, clear and graceful, truly transcendent, with an ethereal air. Now, listening to this piece again, I understand that the bright moon hangs high, illuminating all beings, also expressing compassion and love..."
Evaluation_9.cn: “《明月舒光》此曲……我昔日常在璇女峰中抚琴，也曾有闻。那时只闻曲中偶有女子哼唱之声，清高婉约，端的是出尘脱俗，仙气飘飘；如今再赏此曲，更知晓明月高悬，普照众生，亦有慈悲怜爱之情……”

Evaluation_10.en: "The music piece Iron Will... At first listen, one hears the intertwining sounds of metal, with such a rapid pace, just like a master swordsmith, dedicated and focused, tirelessly crafting unparalleled divine weapons day and night. The exquisiteness within is truly unfathomable..."
Evaluation_10.cn: “《铁号》此曲……乍听便闻金铁之声交错不休，且节奏如此急促，正似铸剑名匠至诚至专，日夜不休赶制绝世神兵，其中精妙，实在深不可测……”

Evaluation_11.en: "The music piece Spring of Snow...The melody is gentle and soothing, exuding a warm atmosphere.The clear and crisp notes are like the sound of ice and snow melting, dripping gently.The rhythm flows slowly, resembling the hidden spring beneath the white snow in Mt. Kongsang, creating a scene akin to the Land of Immortals."
Evaluation_11.cn: “《雪之春》此曲……曲调轻缓，暖意融融。清脆乐音，好似冰雪即将融化，滴滴而落之声；韵律徐徐流动，更似空桑山中白雪藏春，仙境之景……”

Evaluation_12.en: "The music piece Might of Vajra... The piece is filled with Sindhu musical instruments, seeming to be music passed down from Tantric Buddhism.Though the melody is unique, it appears even more eerie, with perhaps three parts resembling Buddhist chants, but the remaining seven parts filled with ominous undertones..."
Evaluation_12.cn: “《唯我无量》此曲……满篇天竺乐器，似是密宗所传之乐。曲风虽独特，却更显诡异，纵有三分佛音之韵，其余七分倒皆是不祥之意了……”

Evaluation_13.en: "The music piece Five Immortals... Only the sounds of Di and Hulusi can be heard, intertwining and lingering, like a pair of butterflies dancing and flying together, graceful and full of heartfelt emotions.Listening to such a melody, the rumored Miaojiang region may not be purely a dangerous place after all..."
Evaluation_13.cn: “《五仙》此曲……只闻笛与葫芦丝之音，缠绵交错，如同一双蛱蝶相依飞舞，翩翩而行，情意悱恻。如此一曲听来，那传闻中的苗疆，或许并非纯然的险地……”

Evaluation_14.en: "The music piece Moment of Malice... The melody is so eerie, with hidden dangers. Even I, upon listening closely to this tune, can't help but furrow my brow. I feel as though lurking shadows may hide in the darkness at any moment. It's wise to stay alert and cautious..."
Evaluation_14.cn: “《杀机》此曲……旋律如此诡异，暗藏危机，即便是我，细听此曲亦不禁蹙眉，只觉不知何处便有可怖阴影匿于黑暗，不妨打起三分精神，小心为上……”

Evaluation_15.en: "The music piece Volcano Horn... Upon first hearing, it feels restless, and the tone is also heavy. The message conveyed by this piece seems to be like a volcano on the verge of erupting. Without the descent of a Divine Loong, the storm will not subside, and the torrential rain will not cease..."
Evaluation_15.cn: “《火山号角》此曲……初闻便觉急躁，音韵亦是厚重，此曲所诉，恰似火山即要喷薄而出，若无神龙降世，则暴风难熄，猛雨不灭……”

Evaluation_16.en: "The music piece Blood Sacrifice... The rhythm is eerie, the music chilling, filled with a bloody aura throughout! Wherever this piece originates from, there must be demonic forces at play. Upon closer listening, it also seems to have a sense of bluff and uncertainty..."
Evaluation_16.cn: “《血祭》此曲……韵律吊诡，乐音森冷，竟满篇皆是血腥煞气！此曲所出之处，必有邪魔当道，细细听来，又好似有几分虚张声势，摇摆不定……”

Evaluation_17.en: "The music piece Nine-fold Palace Gates... The music style is grand and majestic, the melody exuding solemnity and dignity. In the midst of it all, one can faintly hear the sound of bells and chimes. The palace gates, the imperial court overlooking the rivers and mountains, are all vividly presented in the mind's eye..."
Evaluation_17.cn: “《京阙九重》此曲……曲风宏伟壮阔，旋律威严凛然，依稀恍惚之间，钟磬之音犹在，九重城阙，朝京江山，皆是历历在目……”

Evaluation_18.en: "The music piece Bright Moon above the Jin City... The melody is ethereal, imbued with an immortal aura. Hearing this piece is like seeing Chang'e Moon Step again. Beneath the moonlight, the lanterns and towers of the city are like pavilions in the Land of Immortals..."
Evaluation_18.cn: “《锦城明月》此曲……曲风飘渺，浸染仙气，闻此一曲如再见嫦娥奔月，月色之下，锦城灯火楼阁，便皆如阆苑琼楼……”

Evaluation_19.en: "The music piece Ballad of the Mountains and Waters... It sounds like drifting along the Li River, calmly observing the mountains and waters, one feels serene and content. Their heart is intoxicated by picturesque scenery, lost in reverie, yet unaware that the boat has already passed through myriad mountains..."
Evaluation_19.cn: “《山水谣》此曲……如漓江行舟，静观山水，悠然自得；此心醉于如画景致，恍惚之间，却不觉轻舟已过万重山……”

Evaluation_20.en: "The music piece Sun above the Xiang Waters... It has both the graceful and winding beauty of the Xiang Water, as well as a touch of loyalty, courage, and Xiake spirit. Such a blend of strength and tenderness, with a gentle and heroic temperament, truly represents the local customs and sentiments of Xiangyang..."
Evaluation_20.cn: “《襄水之阳》此曲……既有襄水之曼妙宛转，亦有几分忠肝义胆、侠义之风；如此刚柔并济，柔情侠骨，正是襄阳此地世态人情……”

Evaluation_21.en: "The music piece Nine-bend Loong City... The music carries a profound and solemn tone, with a sense of timeless grandeur. It encompasses the changes of countless ages and the vast transformations of the world, all encapsulated in the deep emotions conveyed by the melody..."
Evaluation_21.cn: “《九曲龙城》此曲……乐音厚重，极是庄严肃穆，亘古千秋，沧海桑田，皆寄于曲中所诉悠悠之情……”

Evaluation_22.en: "The music piece Morning Market... The flute melody harmonizes cleverly with the main melody, resembling a conversation between people, as if portraying the bustling scene of the morning market in Guangzhou, with vendors shouting and haggling, and pedestrians coming and going, negotiating prices..."
Evaluation_22.cn: “《早市》此曲……笛音与主旋律巧妙唱和，倒似人之言来语去，恍若广州早市热闹非凡之景，商贩吆喝买卖，行人往来议价……”

Evaluation_23.en: "The music piece Emerald Dome... The rhythm is light and lively, the melody leisurely. The music is arranged in a harmonious and balanced manner, much like the intertwining of trees in the mountains, evoking the scene of a secluded haven..."
Evaluation_23.cn: “《山林有木》此曲……音韵轻快，旋律悠然，乐音错落有致，恰似山中林木交错，世外桃源之景跃然眼前……”

Evaluation_24.en: "The music piece Narrow Pass... It seems to be filled with a sense of oppression, as if walking through a canyon. Every musical phrase seems to express a longing - to walk out of the valley and seek open spaces once again..."
Evaluation_24.cn: “《一线天》此曲……竟满是压抑之感，好似行走峡谷之中，满篇乐句无一不在倾诉：只愿从谷中走出，再寻开阔之处……”

Evaluation_25.en: "The music piece Banyan City... The sound flows like a babbling brook, the melody unfolds gently and gradually. The scenery described in the music must be that of a moist, tranquil city, with a warm and cozy atmosphere..."
Evaluation_25.cn: “《榕城》此曲……音色潺潺如流泉，旋律轻缓娓娓道来，曲中所述景色，必是一座湿润宁静、暖意融融之城……”

Evaluation_26.en: "The music piece The Liao River flows to the East... It is filled with a solemn and tense atmosphere, echoing the sound of marching troops. Each time one hears it, it's like seeing the setting sun casting its glow upon the mountains, with a lone crane returning home, and the vast Liao River flowing eastward for thousands of miles..."
Evaluation_26.cn: “《辽水东去》此曲……满是肃杀之气，行军之声，每每闻之，如见斜阳依山，孤鹤归飞，万里辽水东逝而去……”

Evaluation_27.en: "The music piece Dance of Western Regions... Both the tune and the instruments carry an exotic flavor, with cheerful and lively music pieces full of whimsical charm. It's perfect for dancing along and reveling in joy..."
Evaluation_27.cn: “《西域舞》此曲……无论曲调或是乐器，皆是异域之风，音律皆是欢快活泼，韵味奇趣，正适合随之起舞，纵情欢乐……”

Evaluation_28.en: "The music piece Cangshan Mountains and Erhai Lake... The rhythm is light, unrestricted, as if the melody refuses to be bound by worldly constraints. One can freely roam the Cangshan Mountains and Erhai Lake, feeling carefree and joyous, igniting a playful and whimsical spirit..."
Evaluation_28.cn: “《苍山洱海》此曲……节奏轻松，无拘无束，曲调好似决不受世俗束缚般，尽可徜徉苍山洱海，自在畅快，倒令人起了几分戏乐玩耍之心……”

Evaluation_29.en: "The music piece Sound of Forest... At first, the melody may have a hint of tension, resembling birds startled into flight. However, it gradually leads one into the beautiful scenery of the forest, with a soothing rhythm and graceful, flowing beauty, like being entranced amidst the mountains and woods..."
Evaluation_29.cn: “《林音》此曲……初闻曲调略有几分紧张，恰似鸟儿受惊而飞；此后却引人渐入林中美景，韵律舒缓，优美绵长，如同沉醉山林之间……”

Evaluation_30.en: "The music piece One Night by the West Lake... The melody is gentle, depicting only the night scene of West Lake. The night wind is clear, the sound of Sheng and Xiao gradually fades away. Such a delicate tune, though, doesn't sound lonely at all..."
Evaluation_30.cn: “《西子夜》此曲……旋律悠柔，只为描绘西湖夜景，夜风清净，笙箫渐远，如此婉约之曲，听来却并不寂寞……”

Evaluation_31.en: "The music piece Listening to Qing Qu in Jiangnan... It is like a song of spring, describing the full courtyard of flowers. Hearing it is like seeing the green waves reflecting the willows, flowers attracting bees and butterflies, bringing a moment of delightful intoxication..."
Evaluation_31.cn: “《江南闻清曲》此曲……恰似一曲好春光，诉尽满庭芳；闻之便如见碧波映柳，花留蜂蝶，一时更是神怡心醉……”

Evaluation_32.en: "The music piece Legacy of the Old Capital... While exuding solemnity and gravity, this tune also carries a subtle implication of the vicissitudes of life. Within the fluctuations of the melody, one can sense the profound history and the experiences of enduring hardships, leaving a lasting impression and endless aftertaste..."
Evaluation_32.cn: “《旧都之遗》此曲……虽极是庄严肃穆，却也深藏几分世事更迭的意蕴，旋律起伏之中，便可感历史悠久，饱经沧桑，令人回味无穷……”

Evaluation_33.en: "The music piece Corridor of Deep Valley... The melody is profound, just like a traveler wandering through the valley, while the rhythm is extremely catchy, with seamless transitions, repeating in cycles. Listening to it feels like traversing the winding paths of the Bashu mountains, where a slight misstep could lead to losing one's way, unable to find the starting point or the path forward..."
Evaluation_33.cn: “《深谷回廊》此曲……旋律深沉，恰如山谷之中漫步的行者，韵律又极是规整，乃至首尾相接，循环往复；听来正如那巴蜀山路，蜿蜒盘绕，稍有不慎便迷失方向，寻不得来处与去路……”

Evaluation_34.en: "The music piece Praise of Thousands of Mountains... its sound of the pipa resembles the vast mountains, while the melodious flute evokes the flowing water. This imagery brings to mind the landscape of Guangnan, with its undulating mountains and winding rivers, where the mountains and rivers intertwine endlessly..."
Evaluation_34.cn: “《千山颂》此曲……琵琶之声如同群山， 袅袅笛音犹如流水，正如广南之地貌，既有群山，也多河川，山水相依，延绵不绝……”

Evaluation_35.en: "The music piece Melody of the Grand River... It begins by sketching the vast scenery of the rushing river, transitioning from stillness to motion. As the drums in the music play out the rhythmic pattern reminiscent of Swordsmith Villa, it vividly highlights the majestic grandeur of the great rivers..."
Evaluation_35.cn: “《大江韵》此曲……先是勾勒奔腾大江的广阔之景，又由静到动，待得曲中大鼓铸剑规律演奏之时，便尽数凸显出了大江大河的磅礴大气……”

Evaluation_36.en: "The music piece Intoxicated Amidst the Rift... Only the sound of Xiao can be heard, lingering and echoing, like the overlapping mountains and peaks, one after another. And everyone is travelers, wandering together in it..."
Evaluation_36.cn: “《醉峡间》此曲……只闻箫声悠悠，此起彼伏，似那山峦叠嶂一重又一重，而你我皆是旅人，一同醉行其中……”

Evaluation_37.en: "The music piece Under the Mountain Yun... When the melody extends, it seems to narrate the scenery, while the sound of Zheng and percussion convey a sense of bustling activity. Upon closer listening, one can feel the intertwining of people and scenery within the music, bustling scenes vividly unfolding before one's eyes..."
Evaluation_37.cn: “《云山下》此曲……旋律悠长时乃是诉景，筝音与击乐则更叙几分烟火气息，细听只觉曲中人与景相依，人来人往，热闹景象，竟是跃然眼前……”

Evaluation_38.en: "The music piece Back to the Forest... The sound of Di is light and brisk, with a lively and adorable melody, resembling the cheerful chirping of birds leading one back into the dense forest, where I wander freely among the rugged peaks and ridges..."
Evaluation_38.cn: “《归林》此曲……笛音轻灵短促，旋律活泼可爱，好似鸟儿啼鸣，迎我归去林中，徜徉峻岭峰峦之间……”

Evaluation_39.en: "The music piece Song of Chu Rivers... The melody flows slowly and softly, reminiscent of the gentle tranquility of autumn waters. It evokes a sense of longing, as if the goddess by the Xiang River bank is now nowhere to be found, leaving only the ethereal music to convey a hint of nostalgia.."
Evaluation_39.cn: “《楚水吟》此曲……旋律缓慢，又如秋水般至柔，正如湘江岸边，神女已再难寻见，唯余空灵曲音道出些许思念之情……”

Evaluation_40.en: "The music piece Tides of Meizhou Island... It frequently changes keys, various instrumental sounds echoing one after another, sounding like the ebb and flow of tides, as if one is standing on the shore experiencing the tides firsthand. As the piece reaches its conclusion, there comes a surge of mighty waves within the music, only to recede suddenly, leaving one with endless reminiscences..."
Evaluation_40.cn: “《湄屿听潮》此曲……频频转调，各类器乐之声此起彼伏，听来好似潮升潮落，恰如身临潮汐之岸。及至尾声之时，曲中便有滔天的潮水涌来，又忽而远去，令人回味无穷……”

Evaluation_41.en: "The music piece Cloud of the Sky Pool... The melody is ethereal and dreamy, pleasantly distant, just as its name suggests. Listening to it feels like being surrounded by drifting clouds, gently moving around the realm of a celestial pool..."
Evaluation_41.cn: “《天池云》此曲……曲调飘渺虚幻，悠远怡人，确如其名，听时眼前似有浮云叠叠，绕天池之境，徐徐而动……”

Evaluation_42.en: "The music piece The Guest... The rhythm is captivating, full of exotic charm; it's said that... 'When guests come from afar, there must be fine wine.' Hearing this melody, how can one not yearn for the scenery of the Western Regions?"
Evaluation_42.cn: “《来客》此曲……韵律别饶风致，曲中尽是异域风情；有道是……客从远来，必有美酒，耳闻此曲，又怎能不向往西域景致……”

Evaluation_43.en: "The music piece Hundred-Mile Clouds and Sunset Glow... It uses many exotic instruments from the Miaojiang regions, it is quite intriguing for those hearing it for the first time. The melody is exceptionally beautiful and prolonged. Although there are rumors of the mysterious and strange places in the southwest, after listening to this piece, one might feel that Yunnan could as well be the Land of Immortals..."
Evaluation_43.cn: “《百里云霞》此曲……多用苗疆异域乐器，令人初闻颇感新奇，旋律又极是优美绵长，虽传闻西南妖异诡谲，若听毕此曲，只觉云南之地，或许亦是一处仙境……”

Evaluation_44.en: "The music piece Small Village by the Border Forest... Its melody flows leisurely, exuding a sense of tranquility, completely free from any extravagance or distractions. It must be the result of being unrestrained, constantly wandering between mountains and waters, to produce such a flavor in music..."
Evaluation_44.cn: “《边林小村》此曲……曲调悠然，几分惬意，全无浮华纷扰之意；必是身无拘束，时时徜徉山水之间，方能写出此种风味……”

Evaluation_45.en: "The music piece Western Road at Dusk... The piece is filled with countless tender emotions and exudes a distinct sense of rhythm. The overtones of Di and Zheng vividly depict the beauty of the setting sun, resembling the picturesque waters of Jiangnan in autumn, delicate and captivating..."
Evaluation_45.cn: “《秋水西道夕》此曲……万千柔情，听来颇有韵律之感，且笛与筝的泛音，更勾勒出夕阳西下之美景，恰似江南秋水，婉约动人……”

Evaluation_46.en: "The music piece Small Village by the Border Forest... The clear melody resembles flowing water and carries a sense of elegance and charm. It feels as if walking through a shady woodland, with winding pathways intersecting. It originates from the verdant grove while also merging into the emerald depths..."
Evaluation_46.cn: “《行郊》此曲……乐音清脆如流水，颇具幽雅意趣，好似行路于阴翳树林之中，阡陌交通蜿蜒，既源自翠林，亦没入翠林……”
